limitations: The browser-main runtime embeds structures.xml; browser-worker remains unavailable until its XML parser path has dedicated worker coverage.

External M3A discovery is not part of ordinary codec open. A bounded host adapter enumerates exact .m3a entries only inside caller-owned logical roots and explicit subtrees, completes discovery before publishing any candidates, pins entry revisions, and admits them through ResourceSessionPort only after explicit hash, full skeleton compatibility, and executable-channel checks. The installed SC2 corpus pins the compatible retail Zeratul pair through that route; automatic selection of trustworthy search roots remains a named remainder.
Game support associations remain documented in the codec README until game manifests land in Slice C3.

ATT_ publishes exact bone/<index> targets, while the current scene facet does not publish the bone hierarchy as scene nodes. M3 socket facets are therefore excluded from UVM materialization; no synthetic root-child socket nodes are invented.

Node runtimes decode M3 region positions, indices, normals, the first UV channel, BONE index/name bindings, SEQS/STG/STC/STS clip structure, MATM material identity, MAT_ standard names/blend/flags, LAYR slots joined to resource ids, unambiguous BAT_ region bindings, ATT_ attachment identity/native names, and ATVL volume identity/kind. model-material-source@1 carries identity but no layer or shader-parameter fields, while model-collision-source@1 does not carry ATVL matrices/sizes/vertices; those fields, attachment orientation/rest transforms, exotic material parameters, SD keyframes, IREF rest poses, automatic selection of M3A logical discovery roots during ordinary open, browser-worker deep facets, and writing remain pending.
